channel.title: Watchtower alpha
channel.description: Alpha channel. Items are added by scripts/sign-and-notarize.sh in deep-well-labs/watchtower.

item.title: Angry Porter 0.1.0-alpha.25
item.description: - A header you can act on. On Overview, the three figures at the top are now buttons with a chevron and a hover highlight. AI services opens the live map and names the first two services, with a tooltip listing each service and the data it was sent. Tool calls opens Your day. Sent to AI still opens What left this Mac. "Live map" and "Flags" join the jump links, and the flag count opens the flags (#962). - What today's flags are. A line under the headline counts the day's flags by kind: sent more than usual, new to this Mac, while you were away, and other. It states what the rules recorded and gives no verdict. It is hidden when there are no flags or they could not be read (#965). - Hooks not installed, said plainly. When no agent client has its hooks in place, the tool-call figure reads "Hooks not installed" with an Install link instead of a zero, on Overview and in the menu bar glance. One local notification tells you when hooks that were connected are found missing. Nothing is installed without your review (#951, #952). - Groundwork for permanent protected history continues: an inactive, uninstalled helper service now exists in the source. It is not bundled, registered or connected to recording, and it opens no archive. The store format, retention and Delete controls are unchanged; alpha.24 can still open the store. No new sensor or network connection is added (#943). - Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon. For a signed UTC release date of 2026-11-18, this alpha expires at 00:00 UTC on 2026-12-18, measured from release rather than installation. Update to resume recording; existing records remain available under normal retention and monitored traffic continues unchanged. - Package tests and unsigned Debug and Release builds passed for the Overview changes. Release-specific signed app and filter checks, clean-Mac installation, activation and uninstall, signed expiration and device checks, in-place Sparkle upgrade, a VoiceOver review of the new header and a CPU measurement of the Overview remain unperformed. The founder explicitly accepted deferring these named checks for alpha.25.

item.title: Angry Porter 0.1.0-alpha.24
item.description: - A visual record check you can keep. The separate offline checker offers a local file chooser, clear consistency and checkpoint results, synthetic examples and a downloadable check report. It runs in a browser without the app, an account or uploading records. It is a separate website download, not a new in-app action (#937, #945). - The native app retains alpha.23's stronger Verify and Export checks and its About record checks explanation. The price table was reviewed against provider pages on 2026-11-18 UTC; rates and historical entries remain unchanged (#944). - A matching checkpoint you previously trusted indicates that the covered recorded bytes have not changed, including alteration by an AI agent. It does not establish authorship, AI correctness, complete capture or that an older valid export is the newest copy. A checkpoint taken only from the checked export adds no independent protection. - Permanent protected history and signed receipts remain in development. The archive connection foundation is not connected to recording. The store format, retention and Delete controls are unchanged; alpha.23 can still open the store. No new sensor or network connection is added. - Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon. For a signed UTC release date of 2026-11-18, this alpha expires at 00:00 UTC on 2026-12-18, measured from release rather than installation. Update to resume recording; existing records remain available under normal retention and monitored traffic continues unchanged. - Package tests, unsigned Debug/Release builds, independent checker and website checks passed. Release-specific signed app/filter, clean-Mac installation/activation/uninstall, signed expiration/device, in-place Sparkle upgrade, controlled current-client usage and full minimum-width/keyboard/VoiceOver checks remain unperformed. Direct file-origin, completed browser-download saving, native drag/drop and cross-browser checks of the visual checker also remain unperformed. The founder explicitly accepted deferring these named checks for alpha.24 (#944).

item.title: Angry Porter 0.1.0-alpha.23
item.description: - Check the retained record more carefully. Verify Chain now rejects gaps and negative sequence numbers. Export checks canonical event bytes against stored fields, hashes and chain links before accepting the file (#916, #925). - Know what a successful check means. The Timeline says retained records are internally consistent, with an About record checks explanation beside Verify and Export. It distinguishes consistency from protection against rewriting, incomplete capture and unauthenticated retention summaries (#931). - Take the record and check it yourself. The public guide provides a standalone offline JSON Lines checker, caller-trusted checkpoint comparisons, append-order replay and synthetic edited/truncated examples. Replay never executes recorded tool calls. The checker is a separate download, not part of this app's Verify action (#914, #928). - Current Codex model estimates. The bundled API-list-price table adds the current GPT-6 and GPT-6.2 models, checked against the providers' published pages on 2026-11-18 UTC. Existing rate entries remain unchanged; new entries apply from that UTC date. Figures remain estimates at API list prices, not subscription charges (#931). - Protected permanent history, a separate authenticated archive writer and signed receipts remain in development. The new archive core is not connected to recording. This alpha retains the existing store format, retention and Delete controls; alpha.22 can still open the store. No new sensor, network request or automatic blocking is added. - Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon. For a signed UTC release date of 2026-11-18, this alpha expires at 00:00 UTC on 2026-12-18. Update to resume recording; existing records remain available under normal retention and monitored traffic continues unchanged. - Package build/tests, unsigned Debug and Release builds, independent-checker tests and docs checks passed; the changed Verify explanation and actual Save-panel export were inspected on a separate Debug QA app with a temporary test store. Signed app/filter, clean-Mac, upgrade, signed-expiration/device, current-client usage and full minimum-width/keyboard/VoiceOver coverage remain unperformed. The founder accepted deferring those named checks for alpha.23 (#931).

item.title: Angry Porter 0.1.0-alpha.22
item.description: - Settings in five tabs. Settings is grouped into General, Porter, Alerts, Network & data and About instead of one long scroll. Under the Technical preset the Porter tab is hidden. Store cleanup notes fold into a disclosure (#875, #877). - Porter's packs list. Settings → Porter's packs lists the packs in one catalog shared with angryporter.com, with what is installed and what comes with the app (#871, #873, #876, #884). - The Timeline keeps your place. When a new event arrives at the top, the selected row stays in view if it was on screen; if you had scrolled away, the list is left alone (#879). - A faster network sensor under many open flows. Starting a flow no longer copies every open flow, and at the 20,000-flow limit the oldest flow is found without scanning them all. Measured on a release build of the sensor's public API with synthetic flows: 20,000 flow starts took 8.8 s before and 0.2 s after, and 20,000 more that each evict took 11.5 s before and 0.3 s after. Records written are unchanged; no figure is promised for the app (#837, #838). - No change to what is recorded, retention, sensor scope or redaction, and no new network connection. The records store is unchanged from alpha.21; alpha.21 can still open it. - Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon. This alpha expires at 00:00 UTC on 2026-12-17, 30 UTC calendar days after its signed release date. Update to resume recording; existing records remain available under normal retention and monitored traffic continues unchanged. - CI passed on each merged change and the full local check passed on the released source. The founder runs a signed dogfood build, 0.0.14, with the Settings tabs and the network sensor changes; the Settings Porter-tab hiding, the packs list and the Timeline change came after it. The network sensor's manual checklist on a signed build, clean-Mac installation, the in-place update from alpha.21, signed expiration and device checks and VoiceOver and keyboard checks of the changed views were not performed; the founder accepted deferring them.

item.title: Angry Porter 0.1.0-alpha.21
item.description: - Where the tokens go. Angry Porter reads, from the session logs Claude Code and Codex write on this Mac, only each model response's token counts by type, the model, the time and the session; no prompt, reply, file or tool content is kept, and nothing leaves the Mac. Tokens appear in the menu bar glance, the Overview, a session's summary and Coverage (#774, #775 to #779, #810, #811, #812, #814, #827). - An estimate, not a bill. A dollar figure beside the tokens is always marked "estimate at API list prices", from a price table shipped with the app. Subscriptions, fast mode, batch pricing, service tiers and tool charges are not in it. A session whose log cannot be read says "unknown", never zero (#778, #793). - Spend and token alerts. Settings takes a dollar threshold, a token threshold, or both, over 1 hour, 24 hours or 7 days, per agent. Off until set; notifications off until turned on (#780, #795, #803, #807, #813, #815). - Ask an agent to quit, yourself. "Stop…" on a flag's detail or a session's view, for a Claude Code or Codex session started in a terminal, asks the process once to quit after a confirmation that names it. Never automatic, never forced; programs it started may keep running. Each press is in the Timeline as "Your action". Agents run by an app show no "Stop…" (#781, #782, #783, #801, #809, #826). - Angry Porter observes only, with one exception: you can ask an agent process to quit from the app, and only you can. Nothing is blocked, changed or delayed, nothing leaves the Mac, and no network connection is added. The records store is unchanged; alpha.20 can still open it. - Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon. This alpha expires at 00:00 UTC on 2026-12-14, 30 UTC calendar days after its signed release date. Update to resume recording; existing records remain available under normal retention and monitored traffic continues unchanged. - CI and the full local check passed with both features on; the stop was tried on real scratch sessions; the founder ran a signed dogfood build of the same source. The network sensor's manual checklist on a signed build, clean-Mac installation, the in-place update from alpha.20 and the notification's Stop… action were not performed; the founder accepted deferring them.

item.title: Angry Porter 0.1.0-alpha.20
item.description: - A flag for a tool that keeps failing. Ten failures of one agent tool in a row within five minutes raise one Angry Porter note in the Timeline ("Bash failed 10 times in a row between … and …, as recorded"), within about ten seconds and at most once every half hour per tool. Advisory only: nothing is stopped, blocked or retried. Its notification is off until "A tool fails many times in a row" is turned on in Settings (#549, #550, #784, #786, #788, #798). - Groundwork, switched off. A token and cost meter, spend and token alerts, and a stop the person clicks are built but switched off: no agent session log is read, no meter or alert is shown, and no process can be signalled (#773, ADR-0020, ADR-0021). - One-way step for the records store. Once this version has opened the store, alpha.19 and older versions will not open it; they offer to update or delete. Records are not rewritten. - No change to what the sensors record, retention, sensor scope or redaction, and no new network connection. - Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon. This alpha expires at 00:00 UTC on 2026-12-14, 30 UTC calendar days after its signed release date. Update to resume recording; existing records remain available under normal retention and monitored traffic continues unchanged. - CI passed on each merged change and the full local check passed on each app change. The founder checked the new flag on a local build with synthetic records. Not dogfooded on a signed build; the network sensor's manual checklist on a signed build, clean-Mac installation and the in-place update from alpha.19 were not performed for this release; the founder accepted deferring them.

item.title: Angry Porter 0.1.0-alpha.19
item.description: - Porter's packs. Settings → Porter's packs installs a .porterpack folder of Porter clips, chosen or dropped. Each pack is checked against Deep Well Labs' signature before anything is copied; a pack that fails is refused with the reason. An installed pack shows its edition, clips and buyer, and its clips play at once. Remove takes a pack out; Export copies installed packs beside the export and Delete removes them. Installing sends nothing anywhere. Packs for sale will be announced separately (#642, #742, #744, #747). - Five new Porter clips. Two packs now come with the app: Knocking at the Gate, four more lines from the Porter scene, and Harvest Table, one line for US Thanksgiving. Like the first five, each clip plays once, when what it says is true, and then waits in Settings. Settings → Porter's packs names the packs that come with the app (#642, #745, #748). - Check for Updates from the menu bar. The menu bar icon's right-click menu has Check for Updates… (#750, #752). - Pause the Timeline. Pause holds the live list still; the count beside Resume says how many events arrived meanwhile. A delete, or opening an event from a notification, resumes it (#749, #753). - Settings returns you to the app. Closing Settings opened from the app window brings that window back to the front (#751, #754). - Less memory held while reading records. The flag and digest reads go through the store a page at a time, and cached record windows are let go when unread for ten minutes. Measured on a synthetic store in a test process; no figure is promised for the app (#502, #727). - No change to what is recorded, retention, sensor scope or redaction, and no new network connection. The records store is unchanged; alpha.18 can still open it. - Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon. This alpha expires at 00:00 UTC on 2026-12-14, 30 UTC calendar days after its signed release date. Update to resume recording; existing records remain available under normal retention and monitored traffic continues unchanged. - CI passed on each merged change. The founder ran a signed dogfood build with every change except #752, #753 and #754, and installed a pack signed with the production key on it. The network sensor's manual checklist on a signed build, clean-Mac installation and the in-place update from alpha.18 were not performed for this release; the founder accepted deferring them.

item.title: Angry Porter 0.1.0-alpha.18
item.description: - Network records keep arriving past one bad record. If the app cannot read a batch of network records, the network sensor now narrows down to the single record at fault, sets only that one aside and counts it, and delivers the rest in order. Before, one unreadable batch was offered again every second and held back everything behind it. Settings and the network figures now say when records are not reaching the store (#506, #703, #706). - The Porter in Settings. The Porter's asides, games and clips have their own "The Porter" heading directly under Presentation. The date each clip was offered is shown in full (#693, #697, #700, #701). - Release notes in the update dialog. "Check for Updates" now shows what changed. With a paid license, an update published after the covered range says so in one line; the update is still offered (#428, #705). - Less repeated background work. Client configuration files are parsed again only when they change. Several reads that walked the whole store now read only the newest records or only what was added since the last look. A request to the network sensor that timed out no longer leaves its timer running. The radar, the usual-range charts and the "What left this Mac" diagram redraw less (#497, #698, #503, #699, #704, #492, #702, #505, #707). Measured at rest on a synthetic store, processor use did not change measurably against alpha.17; no speed or battery-life improvement is promised. - One-way step for the records store. Once this version has opened the store, alpha.17 and older versions will not open it; they offer to update or delete. Records are not rewritten. The step exists because the network sensor's hourly status record can now carry the count of records set aside (#506, #706). - No change to what is recorded, retention, sensor scope or redaction, and no new network connection. - Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon. This alpha expires at 00:00 UTC on 2026-12-12, 30 UTC calendar days after its signed release date. Update to resume recording; existing records remain available under normal retention and monitored traffic continues unchanged. - Package tests and both Xcode builds passed on the released source, and the founder ran a signed dogfood build of the same source. The network sensor's manual checklist on a signed build, clean-Mac installation and the in-place update from alpha.17 were not performed for this release; the founder accepted deferring them.
